items.title: Vertex Shares Have The Bull Case Changed After Drug Discovery Deal Renewal
items.summary: Genomics Limited has extended its drug target discovery and validation alliance with Vertex Pharmaceuticals for four more years, a deal that can reach over US$220m in milestone payments plus potential tiered royalties on any resulting therapies. items.title: Vertex Pharmaceuticals (VRTX) Extends Drug Discovery Collaboration For Four Years
